ch27-open.title: Meeting summary AI
ch27-open.standfirst: When a host ends the meeting, an AI recap is written from the transcript and chat — an overview, decisions and action items you can read, regenerate and export.

ch17-log.heading: Reading the transcript & generating a summary
steps: Open the log from the header's Transcript button (the document icon — it shows a count badge when there's a transcript).
The log opens on the Transcript tab: the full conversation, grouped by speaker with avatars, timestamps, and a per-line language tag.
Switch to the Summary tab. If none exists yet, click Generate summary — Gemini reads the full transcript and returns an overview, participants, key topics, decisions, and action items.
Watch for “Generating summary… (~5-15s for long meetings)”; a dot appears on the Summary tab once it's ready.
Click Download .md to save the current tab (transcript or summary) as a Markdown file.
Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> or click outside the modal to close it.
ch17-log.outcome: You've read the record and, if you wanted, pulled a structured recap and a downloadable copy — without changing anything in the finished meeting.

host.html: In a live meeting the footer also offers Clear log (wipes the transcript and summary for the room after a confirm) and Regenerate summary. Both are hidden in review — a finished meeting is extract-only, so you can read and download but never rewrite the record.

ch17-log-ref.heading: Every button in the meeting log
rows: Full chronological transcript, grouped by speaker
AI overview, topics, decisions, action items
Asks Gemini for a recap of the transcript
Replaces an existing summary with a fresh one
Saves the active tab as a Markdown file
Wipes transcript + summary for the room (confirm)
ch17-log-ref.note: The transcript only fills up while someone has speech-to-text turned on during the call. An empty log reads “No transcript yet. Join a call + turn on STT to start recording.”

host.html: Clearing a log empties what you see immediately, but the stored transcript blob still exists — rejoining the room re-hydrates it.

ch22-ai-recap.heading: Read, regenerate and export the AI summary
steps: When a host ends the meeting, Canvas M sends its voice transcript and chat to the AI and writes the result back as the meeting's AI summary — in the background, so ending is never held up. It reads what was said and typed, not the canvas drawing itself.

Read the short version on the meeting's detail panel: open the finished meeting from your project or dashboard and the recap sits in an AI summary card under the hero, with Show more / Show less for long ones.

For the full structured version, open the meeting log (the Transcript icon in the header) and switch to the Summary tab. It lays the recap out as Overview, Participants, Key topics, Decisions and Action items — each action item with an owner and a deadline.

Need a fresh pass, or summarising a meeting that's still running? Press Generate summary (or Regenerate summary). It re-reads the whole transcript and takes roughly 5–15 seconds for a long meeting; you can run it about once a minute.
Press Download .md to save the whole recap as a Markdown file — ready to paste into minutes or an email.
ch22-ai-recap.outcome: The end-of-meeting card is written once and kept with the meeting; the Summary tab can be regenerated whenever you need. In read-only review you can read the recap, but the regenerate and clear buttons are hidden.

note.html: Canvas M doesn't email recaps. A guest of a finished meeting is told “The organizer will share a recap with you separately.” — so download the .md (or copy the card) and send it on yourself.

host.html: The recap is generated only when a host ends the meeting, and only if something was said or typed — an empty meeting produces no card. Anyone who can see the meeting can read the summary and open the log; regenerating is rate-limited to roughly once a minute per person.
